title: Check whether rule ux-swift-same-intent holds for Swift screens
why: Your note on item 183, 11:22 CST Nov 6: send a lane to determine whether ux-swift-same-intent (a Swift screen follows the same four layout rules with its own tools) is right to apply.
note: Nov 6 11:33 CST (triage): an Explore or research lane reads docs/design/layout.md's Swift table and the Swift screens in the owner's iOS repos (home, degen, ios-adblock), and reports per rule whether the Swift tool gives the same outcome. It edits nothing; its report becomes a page question. The coordinator starts it.
